description: T-040: SYSOP RELOAD on the original after play, to flush its activity log (LOGFILE) before m2_live.sh copies it out.

steps.note: MBBSEmu admits one connection per user; the previous sheet's session can still be held for a moment after its logoff ("... is already logged in -- only 1 connection allowed per user", live run 38953732059)
wait for the original to let the previous session go
the name again at the Username prompt MBBSEmu shows after the refusal
SYSOP RELOAD reads the INI again and closes and re-opens the activity log, which is not flushed before, so this writes its lines out
